question: [Fill-in-the-Blank] If the car had continued driving straight on its initial path instead of turning, the 'Baraka' entrance sign would have passed by on the car's ______ side.
control_question: [Single-Choice] What does the camera vehicle do after entering the grassy parking area? [Options] A) Stops at a gatehouse B) Backs into a garage C) Drives past parked RVs D) Crosses a railroad track
rater_1_evidence_note: 车辆先直行接近 Baraka 标牌，随后向右转并从标牌右侧进入；回答把保持初始直线路径时标牌相对车身的左右侧关系判断反了。
rater_2_evidence_note: 20-frame full-duration sheet: the Baraka sign is visible ahead and to the left of the vehicle's initial straight path before the actual rightward turn; the answer reverses the counterfactual passing side.
adjudication_note: 反事实条件要求把车辆初始直线路径继续外推；标牌将从车辆左侧通过，故主要缺口是轨迹反事实预测，车身左右参照为明确次要因素。

question: [Single-Choice] Based on the white van's consistent speed and trajectory, which object would its front bumper be aligned with approximately one second after the video ends? [Options] A) The front of the parked dark-colored SUV. B) The rear of the parked silver sedan. C) The storefront with the red sign in the distance. D) The second light pole on the sidewalk.
model_answer: B) The rear of the parked silver sedan.
control_question: [Single-Choice] Near the start, what is the camera doing as the street is viewed? [Options] A) Moving forward along the sidewalk B) Remaining fixed beside the curb C) Tilting upward toward the trees D) Crossing the street toward cars
control_model_answer: B) Remaining fixed beside the curb
rater_1_evidence_note: 白色厢式车沿道路横向移动，问题要求将末段速度继续外推约一秒；回答将前保险杠的未来对齐目标判为银色轿车，而非第二根灯杆。control 未通过也提示局部运动识别可能参与。
rater_2_evidence_note: 20-frame full-duration sheet: the white van advances steadily past successive curbside landmarks while the camera also moves forward; choosing the parked silver sedan fails to extrapolate the van's final motion to the later light-pole alignment.
adjudication_note: 白色厢式车与移动相机同时变化，错误选到较早的银色轿车位置；除主要的未来外推失败外，连续跟踪末段轨迹是明确次要缺口。

question: [Fill-in-the-Blank] After the helicopter lands, the visual state of the main rotor blades transitions from a continuous transparent blur to ______, as they slow to a stop.
control_question: [Single-Choice] Which surface is visible under the helicopter near its touchdown area? [Options] A) A paved road B) A sandy beach C) A snowy field D) A grassy field
rater_1_evidence_note: 序列显示直升机旋翼由高速模糊逐渐停止并可辨；模型回答 stillness 与题干“as they slow to a stop”在语义上相容，只因未复述“distinct individual blades”而被判错，答案接受范围存在实质问题。
rater_2_evidence_note: 20-frame full-duration sheet: the helicopter rotor changes from motion blur to a visibly stopped rotor; 'stillness' describes that terminal state and is semantically compatible with the prompt although it does not match the preferred wording 'distinct individual blades'.
adjudication_note: “stillness”与旋翼停止后由模糊变为可辨的终态语义相容；题目答案接受范围已足以解释该误计分，没有独立的输出协议或解析失败证据。

question: [True/False] Based entirely on the difference in acceleration between the two motorcycles within the first two seconds of the race, it is predictable that the motorcycle in the right lane will maintain its lead.
control_question: [Single-Choice] After the start, which direction do the motorcycles move across the view? [Options] A) From right to left B) Toward the camera C) From left to right D) Away from the camera
rater_1_evidence_note: 两辆摩托从起步到加速的相对位置持续变化，单凭前两秒差异不足以保证右道车辆维持领先；回答把短时加速度直接外推为持续领先。control 方向题未通过，低层运动方向识别也可能参与。
rater_2_evidence_note: 20-frame full-duration sheet: both motorcycles accelerate left-to-right and their separation changes, but the first two seconds alone do not uniquely establish whether the right-lane motorcycle will maintain its lead for an unspecified future interval.
adjudication_note: 题干仅限定前两秒，却未界定“maintain its lead”的未来时长；短时加速度不能唯一确定该命题，故题目本身存在实质时间范围歧义。若按预设答案解释，模型也表现出把短时趋势直接外推的次要问题。

question: [Fill-in-the-Blank] In the final shot of the video taken by the man in the blue shirt, the puck travels across the floor, passing in front of the ______.
control_question: [Single-Choice] Where is the large black equipment relative to the glass doorway? [Options] A) To the left of it B) Directly in front of it C) Directly behind it D) To the right of it
control_model_answer: D) To the right of it
rater_1_evidence_note: 末段蓝衣男子击出冰球，冰球横穿地面朝右侧坐着的人及器材区域运动；回答将其经过的前景对象绑定为球门，混淆了末段轨迹与目标区域。
rater_2_evidence_note: 20-frame full-duration sheet: in the final shot the puck crosses the floor in front of the seated person/equipment area, whereas the goal belongs to a different spatial location and earlier play context.
adjudication_note: 末段冰球轨迹的主要问题仍是时空定位；“goal”还把经过的可见参照对象识别成另一场景物体，但没有证据表明这是动作意图或目标绑定。

question:
[Single-Choice] Based on the silver car's final trajectory after swerving across the lane divider, what was its immediate spatial objective?
[Options]
A) To make a U-turn.
B) To pull over on the left shoulder.
C) To turn right at the upcoming intersection.
D) To overtake the black car.
model_answer: C) To turn right at the upcoming intersection.
control_question: [Single-Choice] Near the start of the event, what is the black car doing? [Options] A) Turning left B) Stopping at the roadside C) Driving straight ahead D) Reversing backward
rater_1_evidence_note: 银色车横跨分道线并改变航向，回答把该机动的目标绑定为前方路口右转，而 gold 解释为掉头；仅凭截取轨迹难以直接观察驾驶意图，目标表述存在一定推断性。
rater_2_evidence_note: 20-frame full-duration sheet: the silver car crosses leftward ahead of the camera and continues rotating back across the roadway, supporting an immediate U-turn objective; the answer binds the maneuver to a right turn at the intersection.
adjudication_note: 20帧序列显示银色车跨线后持续旋转并横过道路，近期掉头目标可由完整轨迹支持；次要缺口是未连续整合该机动过程，而非题目无法判定。

question: [True/False] As the two individuals walk along the shoreline, the tall, multi-story building in the background appears to move from the right side of the camera's view towards the center.
control_question: [Single-Choice] Where is the long pier relative to the two beachgoers? [Options] A) Behind them to the viewer's right B) Behind them to the viewer's left C) In front of them to the viewer's right D) Between them in the foreground
control_model_answer: [Answer] A) Behind them to the viewer's right
rater_1_evidence_note: 两人沿海岸行走时高层建筑在序列中基本位于画面中央偏左，并未从右侧移到中央；回答错误概括了背景地标随移动相机产生的相对位移。
rater_2_evidence_note: 20-frame full-duration sheet: the selfie camera changes pose while the beachgoers walk, but the tall building remains in the same background sector rather than translating from image-right to center; the answer confuses camera-relative apparent motion.
adjudication_note: 高层建筑在完整序列中未由画面右侧移向中央；错误首先是未跟踪背景地标随时间的画面位置，相机姿态变化造成的参照影响为次要因素。

question: [True/False] From the moment the group of four pedestrians becomes fully visible, they are always positioned to the allocentric left of the yellow car.
control_question: [Single-Choice] What is the yellow car doing as the camera approaches it? [Options] A) Driving toward the camera B) Turning across the street C) Parked along the roadside D) Reversing into traffic
rater_1_evidence_note: 相机沿街移动并先后经过黄色车与四名行人，需在稳定场景坐标中比较双方左右位置；回答以移动画面中的瞬时位置概括为始终在左侧。
rater_2_evidence_note: 20-frame full-duration sheet: the pedestrian group and yellow parked car change their left-right ordering as the moving camera passes them; 'always left' fails over the full visible interval.
adjudication_note: 问题要求在移动相机下用场景坐标比较行人与黄色车；回答把画面瞬时左右关系当成稳定的allocentric关系，主要是参照系锁定失败，“always”还要求次要的全时段跟踪。

question: [Single-Choice] As the camera pans right, how does the perceived spatial relationship between the small arched section of the track and the large white-tarped structure change? [Options] A) The arched section moves from being below the white structure to being above it. B) The arched section moves from being to the right of the white structure to being directly in front of it. C) The white structure moves from being behind the arched section to being beside it. D) The arched section and the white structure maintain a fixed side-by-side position.
model_answer: C) The white structure moves from being behind the arched section to being beside it.
control_question: [Single-Choice] Near the end, what is the camera view passing alongside? [Options] A) A row of parked cars B) A wooden roller coaster framework C) A water slide tower D) A chain-link fence line
control_model_answer: B) A wooden roller coaster framework
rater_1_evidence_note: 右移镜头使前景拱形轨道与后方白色覆布结构的投影关系连续变化；回答将变化描述为白色结构由后方移到旁侧，未正确跟踪两物体的相对投影。
rater_2_evidence_note: 20-frame full-duration sheet: the rightward pan changes the projected vertical relation of the foreground arched track and the white-tarped structure; the answer instead describes a behind-to-beside depth change.
adjudication_note: 右移镜头改变前景拱轨与远处白色结构的投影关系；模型把由视点造成的垂直投影变化误述为深度关系变化，连续跟踪投影为次要因素。

question: [Single-Choice] During the camera's upward pan, what is the apparent change in the position of the blue star-shaped light in the foreground relative to the red and white star-shaped light behind it? [Options] A) The blue light moves from being below the red light to being above it. B) The blue light appears to move further down and to the left relative to the red light. C) The two lights maintain a fixed spatial relationship to each other in the frame. D) The blue light moves from being to the left of the red light to its right.
model_answer: A) The blue light moves from being below the red light to being above it.
control_question: [Single-Choice] Where is the red teardrop-shaped ornament positioned relative to the red-and-white star decoration? [Options] A) lower left of it B) upper right of it C) upper left of it D) lower right of it
rater_1_evidence_note: 蓝色与红白星形灯固定在同一装饰结构上，镜头上摇时二者相对位置保持不变；回答错误声称蓝灯由下方移到上方。
rater_2_evidence_note: 20-frame full-duration sheet: the blue foreground star and red-white star are fixed decorations and retain their relative arrangement during the shared upward camera pan; the answer invents a relative crossing.
adjudication_note: 两盏固定灯在共同上摇中保持相对位置；回答虚构跨越，主要是跨帧关系保持失败，区分共同相机运动与物体相对运动构成次要参照因素。

question: [True/False] From the camera's final viewpoint showing the side of the car, the driver's side front wheel is completely occluded.
control_question: [Single-Choice] Before the man stands apart from the car near the bushes, what does he do? [Options] A) He opens a car door. B) He kneels beside a wheel. C) He enters the car. D) He walks beside the car.
rater_1_evidence_note: 最终侧视镜头中驾驶员侧前轮主要因相机裁切而离开画面，并非被另一物体遮挡；题干把 out of frame 写成 completely occluded，gold 的概念边界不清。
rater_2_evidence_note: 20-frame full-duration sheet: in the final side view the driver's front wheel is outside/fully occluded from the camera view while the rear wheel remains visible; the negative answer contradicts the final frame state.
adjudication_note: 最终镜头中前轮是被画面裁切到视野外，而非被另一物体遮挡；题干把out of frame称为completely occluded，模型否定回答具有合理依据，因此不再附加内容错误标签。

question: [Multiple-Select] Based on the visual evidence of the skull's transformation, which of the following physical changes occur? (Select all that apply) [Options] A) The material transitions from a rigid solid to a viscous semi-liquid. B) The object's volume significantly increases. C) The defined anatomical features collapse into an undefined shape. D) The material changes color from white to clear.
control_question: [Single-Choice] Where is the small white bottle positioned relative to the skull as liquid is poured? [Options] A) Below the skull B) Above the skull C) Beside the skull D) In front of the skull
rater_1_evidence_note: 白色骷髅由有明确特征的刚性外形塌缩为黏稠无定形物并向桌面铺展；回答额外选择“体积显著增加”，把占地面积扩张误当成材料体积增加。
rater_2_evidence_note: 20-frame full-duration sheet: the rigid skull collapses into a viscous undefined mass, but its material spreads rather than showing a supported significant volume increase; the answer adds unsupported option B.
adjudication_note: 变化在当前画面中直接可见，错误是把铺展后的投影面积增加当作“体积显著增加”；无需未来或反事实推演，故不保留物理预测次标签。

question: [True/False] Relative to the scooter's deck, the person initiates the handlebar spin by pushing their right hand forward and pulling their left hand backward.
control_question: [Single-Choice] Near the beginning, what does the person do with one foot on the pavement? [Options] A) Kicks a ball across the pavement B) Steps onto the grass C) Pushes off to move the scooter D) Jumps with both feet together
control_model_answer: C) Pushes off to move the scooter
rater_1_evidence_note: 把手旋转发生得很快，题目要求相对踏板判断双手的前后推动方向；回答否定了右手前推、左手后拉的可见起始动作。20-frame full-duration sheet 对手部瞬时方向的采样有限。
rater_2_evidence_note: 20-frame full-duration sheet: the rider initiates the bar spin with opposite fore-aft hand motions relative to the scooter deck; the false answer fails the deck-centered right/left hand direction.
adjudication_note: 题目明确要求相对滑板踏板判断左右手的前后运动，主要缺口是踏板中心参照下的方向判定；快速手部动作识别是次要因素。

question: [Fill-in-the-Blank] To transition the wheel from a locked to an unlocked state, the man must pivot the three red levers ______ from the face of the wheel's hub.
control_question: [Single-Choice] What happens before the man kneels beside the rear wheel? [Options] A) He opens a cabinet door. B) He walks around the bicycle. C) He removes the saddle. D) He rides the bicycle away.
rater_1_evidence_note: 近景操作显示三根红色拨杆从轮毂表面向外翻开以解锁；回答将直接可见的枢转方向判为向内。control 未通过也支持操作动作识别困难。
rater_2_evidence_note: 20-frame full-duration sheet: the three red hub levers visibly pivot away from the wheel face to release the lock; the answer reverses the directly shown lever direction.
adjudication_note: 三根红色拨杆直接从轮毂面向外翻开；主要感知识别标签已涵盖方向看反，没有独立的目标绑定或跨时段定位证据，次标签留空。

question: [Multiple-Select] Which of the following spatial properties of the large green fabric are visibly changed by the person's folding action? (Select all that apply) [Options] A) Its total surface area. B) Its thickness in the folded region. C) The number of layers presented to the pattern. D) Its overall shape from a top-down view.
model_answer: B) Its thickness in the folded region.
control_question: [Single-Choice] Which object is visible beneath the materials being handled? [Options] A) A wooden dining table B) A metal baking tray C) A blue ironing board D) A green gridded cutting mat
control_model_answer: D) A green gridded cutting mat
rater_1_evidence_note: 绿色布料折叠后不仅局部厚度增加，也形成多层且俯视轮廓改变；回答只选 B，遗漏了跨折叠前后可见的层数和形状变化。
rater_2_evidence_note: 20-frame full-duration sheet: folding the green fabric increases local thickness, creates multiple layers, and changes its top-down outline; selecting only thickness omits the visible layer and shape changes.
adjudication_note: 需比较折叠前后才能确认厚度、层数及俯视轮廓同时改变；只选厚度主要反映状态变化整合不全，遗漏可见层数和形状为次要识别缺口。

question: [Single-Choice] If the rider failed to navigate the first significant curve and continued in a straight line, what would be the immediate spatial consequence? [Options] A) They would travel off the steep edge to the left of the road. B) They would ride directly into the uphill embankment. C) They would enter the patch of green trees on the right. D) They would safely continue onto a different path.
model_answer: A) They would travel off the steep edge to the left of the road.
control_question: [Single-Choice] What is the person on the motorcycle doing near the bushes? [Options] A) Standing still beside the bike B) Leaning the bike while moving C) Pushing the bike uphill D) Lifting the bike onto a truck
control_model_answer: B) Leaning the bike while moving
rater_1_evidence_note: 骑手在首个明显弯道沿道路右转，若保持此前直线将直接进入弯外侧上坡土坡；回答错误外推为冲出左侧陡边。
rater_2_evidence_note: 20-frame full-duration sheet: the rider approaches a significant bend with the uphill dirt embankment lying on the straight-line continuation; failing to steer would carry the bike into that bank, not over the left edge.
adjudication_note: 直线延续会进入弯外侧上坡土坡；在主要反事实外推之外，回答把道路两侧地形方向反置，保留参照系次标签。

question: [Single-Choice] After the second golfer (in the black shirt) putts, what is the final spatial relationship between his ball and the hole compared to its starting position? [Options] A) The ball is closer to the hole. B) The ball is further from the hole. C) The ball is in the same location relative to the hole. D) The ball has moved to the right of the hole.
model_answer: B) The ball is further from the hole.
control_question: [Single-Choice] Which object is visible on the putting green near the golfers? [Options] A) A yellow flagstick B) A red tee marker C) A sand rake D) A water hazard sign
rater_1_evidence_note: 黑衣球手推杆后球从起点向洞杯区域移动并最终更接近洞口；回答判断为更远，未正确对应击球前后的球位。20-frame full-duration sheet 中小球分辨率有限。
rater_2_evidence_note: 20-frame full-duration sheet: the black-shirted golfer's ball starts farther from the yellow-flagged hole and finishes visibly nearer after the putt; the answer reverses the start-to-end distance change.
adjudication_note: 黑衣球手击球前后距离比较属于主要时空定位；小球尺寸很小且末位不易辨认，实体位置识别是比动作目标绑定更直接的次要证据。

question: [Fill-in-the-Blank] A utility pole temporarily occludes the man. Immediately after he reappears, he is on the ______ side of the white parked car.
control_question: [Single-Choice] Where is the white parked car located relative to the storefront? [Options] A) In front of the storefront B) Behind the storefront C) Across the road from the storefront D) Inside the storefront
rater_1_evidence_note: 移动镜头经过电线杆后男子重新出现时位于白色停放车辆的场景左侧；回答给出右侧，混淆了遮挡前后位置与画面参照。
rater_2_evidence_note: 20-frame full-duration sheet: after the utility-pole occlusion, the man reappears on image-left of the white parked car; the answer reverses the post-occlusion side.
adjudication_note: 问题锚定电线杆遮挡后的瞬间，必须跨短暂遮挡保持人物连续性；主要是时空定位，重现后相对白车的左右判定构成次要参照因素。

question: [Fill-in-the-Blank] After the helicopter lands, the visual state of the main rotor blades transitions from a continuous transparent blur to ______, as they slow to a stop.
control_question: [Single-Choice] Which surface is visible under the helicopter near its touchdown area? [Options] A) A paved road B) A sandy beach C) A snowy field D) A grassy field
rater_1_evidence_note: 旋翼由高速透明模糊变为低速可辨状态；模型回答 clear 可自然解释为 blades become visually clear，与 gold distinct individual blades 基本同义，填空评分边界不充分。
rater_2_evidence_note: 20-frame full-duration sheet: after landing the blurred rotor resolves into clearly visible individual blades; the fill 'clear' plausibly describes this same visual transition even though it is less explicit than the keyed phrase.
adjudication_note: “clear”可自然表达旋翼由透明模糊转为清晰可辨，与题钥核心语义一致；主标签已确定为答案接受范围歧义，无额外解析失败证据。

question: [Single-Choice] What is the consistent spatial relationship between the snowboarder and their shadow throughout the video? [Options] A) The shadow is always directly behind them. B) The shadow is cast to their right and slightly behind them. C) The shadow is cast to their left and slightly in front of them. D) The shadow is not visible.
control_question: [Single-Choice] Which event happens before the snowboarder rises into the air off a snow lip? [Options] A) They sit down on the snow. B) They lift the snowboard by hand. C) They walk uphill on foot. D) They crouch low while riding.
control_model_answer: D) They crouch low while riding.
rater_1_evidence_note: 可见阴影持续位于滑雪者画面左侧并略偏前方；回答判为右后方，错误识别了稳定的基本方向关系。
rater_2_evidence_note: 20-frame full-duration sheet: the snowboarder's shadow consistently falls to the rider's left and slightly forward across turns; the response reverses both side and fore-aft relation.
adjudication_note: “their left/right and front/behind”要求把阴影位置转换到滑雪者自身参照，而非直接采用画面左右；阴影边界识别为次要感知因素。

question: [Single-Choice] As the camera pans to the left, what is the apparent motion of the small puff of smoke on the distant hillside relative to the dock's corner post in the foreground? [Options] A) The smoke appears to move from the right side of the post to the left side of it. B) The smoke remains stationary directly behind the post. C) The smoke appears to move from the left side of the post to the right side of it. D) The smoke is never visible at the same time as the corner post.
model_answer: The smoke appears to move from the right side of the post to the left side of it.
control_question: [Single-Choice] Which visible event occurs before the leafy tree canopy enters the view? [Options] A) A large tree trunk fills the left side. B) A white rectangular roof appears near the dock. C) Benches appear beneath the tree. D) The canopy covers much of the top edge.
control_model_answer: B) A white rectangular roof appears near the dock.

question: [Single-Choice] At 0:17, the player in the blue vest passes the ball off-screen to the right. question: [Single-Choice] If the rider failed to navigate the first significant curve and continued in a straight line, what would be the immediate spatial consequence? question: [Fill-in-the-Blank] A third, less illuminated jellyfish starts below the main jellyfish on the left. As the main jellyfish moves down, it briefly occludes the third one. From the viewer's perspective, the third jellyfish re-emerges to the ________ of the main jellyfish's bell.

question: [True/False] From the camera's final viewpoint showing the side of the car, the driver's side front wheel is completely occluded.

question: [Fill-in-the-Blank] During the camera's pan to the right, the two orange lighters on the dark brown pegboard move from the right side of the frame towards the ______.
control_question: [Single-Choice] Which object is visible on the wooden shelves near the hanging display? [Options] A) soccer balls B) metal cups C) potted plants D) paint cans
rater_1_evidence_note: 右摇镜头过程中深棕挂板上的两只橙色打火机从画面右侧移到中部附近；回答称移到左侧，错误概括末位投影。
rater_2_evidence_note: 20-frame full-duration sheet: during the right pan the two orange lighters move from frame-right into the center region, not all the way to frame-left; the response overextends their apparent displacement.

question: [True/False] At 0:11, from the camera's direct line of sight, the white horse is positioned horizontally between the two brown horses.

rater_1_evidence_note: 约 0:11 的直视画面中白马在水平方向位于两匹棕马之间；回答 False 否认该同时位置关系。
rater_2_evidence_note: 20-frame full-duration sheet: around 0:11 the white horse is horizontally framed between the two brown horses in the direct view; the negative answer misses that visible ordering.
adjudication_note: 白马位于两匹棕马之间是直接可见关系，主标签为感知识别；题目还要求锁定约0:11的同步构图，因此时刻定位是明确次要要求。

question: [Fill-in-the-Blank] The person's hand first points to the lit candle, then pans left and points to the jar of shells, and finally moves the ______.
control_question: [Single-Choice] As the hand passes over the sink area, what does it briefly do? [Options] A) Clenches into a fist. B) Spreads its fingers open. C) Turns the faucet handle. D) Picks up the soap bottle.

rater_2_evidence_note: 20-frame full-duration sheet: the final moved object is the rectangular tissue box; 'paper towel box' is an imprecise but visually referential name for the same dispenser-like box, making strict fill-word rejection questionable.
adjudication_note: 末段移动的是装有抽取式纸品的矩形盒；paper towel box虽不如tissue box精确，但仍明确指向同一可见物体，严格按名词细分判错缺乏答案接受边界，因此不附加内容错误标签。

question: [Multiple-Select] The prominent ripples seen on the water's surface are primarily generated by which of the man's movements? (Select all that apply) [Options] A) The downward and circular push of his feet. B) The side-to-side sculling motion of his hands. C) The movement of his head as he looks around. model_answer: B) The side-to-side sculling motion of his hands.
control_question: [Single-Choice] As the man floats in the water, which side of his torso is facing upward? [Options] A) His back side B) His chest/front side C) His left side D) His right side
rater_1_evidence_note: 水面明显涟漪同时由脚向下/绕圈蹬水和双手左右划水产生；回答只选手部动作，遗漏足部的直接扰水。
rater_2_evidence_note: 20-frame full-duration sheet: prominent surface ripples are generated by both the downward/circular foot push and hand sculling; selecting only hand motion omits the visible foot contribution.
adjudication_note: 涟漪与足部及手部扰水均直接可见，主标签为动作/效应识别；确认两种动作各自伴随水面变化需要跨时段对应，保留时空定位次标签。

question: [Single-Choice] As the camera pans to the left, what is the apparent motion of the small puff of smoke on the distant hillside relative to the dock's corner post in the foreground? [Options] A) The smoke appears to move from the right side of the post to the left side of it. B) The smoke remains stationary directly behind the post. control_question: [Single-Choice] Which visible event occurs before the leafy tree canopy enters the view? [Options] A) A large tree trunk fills the left side. B) A white rectangular roof appears near the dock. C) Benches appear beneath the tree. D) The canopy covers much of the top edge.
rater_1_evidence_note: 左摇镜头使远处烟雾相对近处角柱产生可见视差，模型所述由右向左有视觉依据；gold stationary directly behind 难由序列稳定支持。
rater_2_evidence_note: 20-frame full-duration sheet: the distant smoke remains aligned behind the dock corner post during the left pan; the response mistakes camera motion for a right-to-left relative crossing.
adjudication_note: 远处烟雾尺寸很小，前景角柱随左摇产生明显视差；20帧不能唯一证明烟雾始终正好位于柱后，模型的由右向左描述有视觉依据。若采用题钥解释，参照视差为次要困难。

question: [Single-Choice] During the drift, the car travels along a curved path around the prominent orange cone. Relative to the center of this curve, where is the cone located? [Options] A) On the inside of the curve. B) On the outside of the curve. C) The car's path goes directly over the cone. D) The cone is located exactly at the center of the curve.
model_answer: B) On the outside of the curve.
control_question: [Single-Choice] Which background feature is visible beyond the open driving area? [Options] A) A city skyline B) An ocean shoreline C) Indoor stadium seats D) A forested hillside
rater_1_evidence_note: 漂移车围绕橙色锥桶形成弧线，锥桶位于转弯弧的内侧；回答将轨迹内外关系反转。
rater_2_evidence_note: 20-frame full-duration sheet: the car arcs around the orange cone and leaves the cone on the concave/inside side of its curved trajectory; the response reverses the curve-centered relation.
adjudication_note: inside/outside以车辆曲线路径的曲率中心为参照；锥桶位于弧线凹侧，回答把该曲线中心关系反转，跨帧建立完整漂移弧为次要时空要求。

question: [Multiple-Select] As the man walks from the doorway to the red car, which vehicle in the background is temporarily hidden from view by his body? [Options] A) The grey Land Rover. B) The small black Smart car. C) The blue sedan. D) The white convertible.
control_question: [Single-Choice] Which accessory is visible around the walking man's neck? [Options] A) A bright green lanyard B) A red scarf C) A black tie D) A blue headset
rater_1_evidence_note: 男子从门口走向红车时身体先后覆盖小黑 Smart、蓝色轿车和白色敞篷车；回答只保留 B、C，遗漏短暂被遮挡的 D。20-frame full-duration sheet 对瞬时完全遮挡覆盖有限。
rater_2_evidence_note: 20-frame full-duration sheet: as the man crosses toward the red car, his body successively overlaps the small black Smart car, blue sedan, and white convertible; omitting D misses a visible temporary occlusion.
adjudication_note: 男子行进中先后短暂遮挡Smart、蓝色轿车和白色敞篷车；回答遗漏D，主要是未整合全时段遮挡序列，辨认短暂露出的白色敞篷车为次要感知因素。

question: [Single-Choice] From the camera's perspective, the shoreline appears to be moving from right to left. What is the boat's actual direction of travel relative to the distant dam visible at the start of the video? [Options] A) Towards the dam. B) Away from the dam. C) Parallel to the dam. control_question: [Single-Choice] In the opening view, where is the tree-covered shoreline relative to the camera? [Options] A) Along the right side of the water B) Straight across the near foreground C) Centered far ahead on the horizon D) Along the left side of the water

rater_1_evidence_note: 岸线在画面中右向左滑动主要来自相机绕船观察/转向；远处水坝相对船没有持续缩小的证据，回答把表观背景流误解为船远离水坝。

question: [Single-Choice] At the very beginning of the video, as the silver Corvette drives past, which object in the background does it temporarily and completely occlude from the camera's view? [Options] A) The red Porsche. B) A white SUV. C) A distant building. D) The blue Subaru.

question: [Multiple-Select] The operator's intent is to test the drone's 'follow me' capability. Which of the following spatial behaviors are observed in the drone's attempt to follow the operator? (Select all that apply) [Options] A) The drone initially drifts without tracking the operator's movement. B) The drone successfully matches the operator's forward speed perfectly. model_answer:
A) The drone initially drifts without tracking the operator's movement.
C) The drone adjusts its position laterally to keep the operator in the camera's view.

rater_2_evidence_note: 20-frame full-duration sheet: the follow-me test includes later speed matching, lateral recentering, and a noticeable loss of altitude; selecting initial drift instead of the matched-speed and altitude behaviors misbinds the observed motion to the test goal.
adjudication_note: 多选项要求整合follow-me测试中初始、横向修正、速度和高度的多个阶段；回答加入A并遗漏B、D，主要是完整行为序列整合不全，将运动行为对应到测试目标为次要因素。

question: [Single-Choice] Based on the woman's path of movement from the sidewalk and the sudden appearance of a light source from above and behind her around the 5-second mark, what spatial interaction most likely occurred? question: [True/False] For most of the ride, the surfer is moving along the face of the wave, causing the surfboard to travel in a direction roughly parallel to the shoreline.

question: [True/False] After the surfer is completely occluded by the whitewater at the end of the ride, they have ended up in front of the breaking part of the wave.

question: [Single-Choice] Based on the camera's final position and direction of movement, if it continued to pan forward along the kayak's centerline, what would be the next major feature to come into view? question: [Single-Choice] If the woman in the black dress were to turn 180 degrees, what would be directly in her line of sight? [Options] A) The man carrying a basket on his shoulder. B) A stone fountain. C) The large arched doorway. D) The woman with her back to the camera.
